name: Brain Booster
description: A number-memory game: memorize the numbers while they are visible, then click them in ascending order after they disappear.
overview: Brain Booster is a quick memory challenge. Study the numbers while they are briefly visible, then select them in ascending order once they disappear. It is built with libGDX and runs in the browser through GWT.
features: Memorize numbers during a limited preview
Select the hidden numbers in ascending order
Challenge memory, focus and number sequencing
Runs in any modern browser, no install needed
benefits: A clear, replayable memory-game loop that is easy to extend
A good starting point for publishing a casual brain-training game
Cross-platform libGDX setup for web, desktop, Android and iOS

includes: Gradle build for web, desktop, Android and iOS
Placeholder art so the project builds
excludes: Game name, logo and store listing

requirements.label: IDE
requirements.value: Android Studio or IntelliJ IDEA (iOS builds need a Mac with Xcode)
